ImageDescription.value: Jagadish Pandit's Sripat along with Jagannath temple at Jasra in Nadia district, West Bengal. Jagadish Pandit was one of the Dvadasa-gopala, or twelve cowherd boys of Shri Chaitanya. It is said that both Chaitanya Dev and Nityananda Prabhu visited this temple. The wooden deity of Jaggannath is said to have been brought by Jagadish Pandit by foot from Puri. Later King of Nadia Krishnachandra built up this temple.
